Derived downloads from the Michigan Weather Continuity prototype
=================================================================

benzonia-hourly.csv, benzonia-daily.csv and benzonia-maintenance.txt were
extracted from HTML report pages captured on 2026-10-12. Cell values are the
strings printed by the source, including the missing-value markers --, ---
and NA, which the source does not define and which are not zero.
